body: I can confirm this issue. Quick workaround is to use `@TestHTTPResource("your-root-path")`. I am not quite sure if this is an intended behaviour.

issue.title: Take HTTP root path into account when using @TestHTTPResource
Disallow mixing @QuarkusTest and @QuarkusMainTest
issue.body:
These two can step on each other's toes too easily
(and lead to hard to diagnose errors), so let's make
the failure explicit

Relates to: #27247
